verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's own docs say you can connect MCP servers as a knowledge source, so it acts as an MCP client and pulls context from documentation, design, and project-management tools during reviews and chat. The pricing page also lists 'MCP connections' as a product feature. Missing for 10: detail on setup (which servers, transports, auth), evidence that it invokes action-style tools beyond pulling context, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Use MCP servers as a knowledge source to give CodeRabbit additional context from your documentation systems, design tools, and project management platforms during reviews and chat.
